contracts.boundary: A complete proposal larger than the former 4,000-character limit is reviewed in sequential pages in real pinned Pi, with explicit final Apply, resize/cancel fail-closed behavior, and exactly one saved source. Oversized proposals beyond the hard review bound are rejected before approval.
contracts.assertions: A 6,000-character value and its final hidden suffix appear during traversal before Apply; early Apply, cancellation, tiny viewports, resize reset, and exact single-source persistence are checked in isolated Pi. Unit tests accept a 5,000-character proposal, reject a proposal beyond the 2,000,000-character review bound, retain stale guards, and verify Unicode/whitespace wrapping. Mutating the bound back to 4,000 makes the exact large-proposal invariant test fail.

boundaryTest.name: requires complete paged approval in real pinned Pi across viewport resize

invariant.name: shows complete large changes for approval and rejects proposals beyond the review bound

fault.name: shows complete large changes for approval and rejects proposals beyond the review bound
